name: Preparation for Ceremony

angles.text: Headdresses crafted from natural materials are deeply tied to tauren honor and rites of passage before the high chieftain. Helping fashion such regalia reflects the communal spirit and pride of the tribes of Mulgore.
Aiding a fellow member of the Horde in their traditional ceremonial duties honors the customs of the tauren allies atop the mesas of Thunder Bluff.

faq.answer: The ceremony marks a tauren presenting himself before Chief Cairne Bloodhoof. To mark this honorable occasion, his sibling is crafting a special ceremonial headdress fashioned from tanned leather and vibrant feathers.
faq.q: What ceremony is being prepared for?

faq.answer: Chief Cairne Bloodhoof is the venerable high chieftain and leader of the united tauren tribes, ruling from the high mesas of Thunder Bluff. Standing before him is a distinct honor for any tauren.

aliases: why do we need harpy feathers
faq.answer: The ceremonial headdress requires feathers of a specific size and striking plumage—specifically azure and bronze—to complete the traditional design while the leather straps are being tanned.
faq.q: Why are harpy feathers needed for the headdress?

aliases: where are azure and bronze feathers
faq.answer: The harpies that yield these plumage feathers dwell in the rugged lands far to the north and northwest of Thunder Bluff in Mulgore.

Harpies are vicious, avian-humanoid creatures nesting in the rocky crags around Mulgore. Aside from posing a threat to travelers and the tribes, their large, colorful plumage makes them a prime source for ceremonial ornaments.
faq.q: What role do harpies play in Mulgore?

faq.answer: A dedicated artisan tans the leather straps and constructs the headdress to honor their brother as he prepares to make his appearance before the chieftain.
faq.q: Who is crafting the ceremonial headdress?

sections.body: In tauren culture, standing before Chief Cairne Bloodhoof is an occasion of great pride and reverence. Such milestones demand proper ceremonial attire, particularly a traditional headdress carefully fashioned from treated leather and symbolic plumage. Crafting this regalia is considered an honor by family members, who take great care to ensure every component reflects dignity and respect before the leader of the united tribes.
sections.title: Honoring the Chieftain

sections.body: Constructing a ceremonial headdress requires both skill and specific materials. While supple leather straps are tanned to form the base band, long and pristine feathers must be sourced to adorn the crown. The avian harpies roosting across the craggy hills to the north and northwest of Thunder Bluff provide feathers of the exact size and coloration required, calling upon travelers to venture into hostile nests to retrieve them.
sections.title: Feathers of the Crags

summary: Preparation for Ceremony is a tauren tradition focused on crafting a ceremonial headdress for one preparing to appear before Chief Cairne Bloodhoof. To finish the traditional attire, vibrant feathers must be collected from dangerous harpies nesting beyond Thunder Bluff while the leather bands are prepared.
